course_name_original: Oficina Técnica, Legislación y Normalización en Ingeniería Industrial (21720049)
course_name_en: Technical Office, Legislation and Standardization in Industrial Engineering
prerequisites: It is highly recommended that the student has acquired the competencies corresponding to the subjects in previous semesters.
It is recommended that students do not take this subject until most of the subjects that make up the degree have been passed, especially those related to Machine and Installation Design.

learning_outcomes.text: Creativity and inventive spirit in solving scientific-technical problems.
Attitude of motivation for quality and continuous improvement
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to draft, sign and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering that aim to,
Ability to direct the activities that are the subject of the engineering projects described in competence CG01.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks
Ability to apply knowledge in practice
Ability to work in a team
Ability to adapt to new situations.
Aptitude for oral and written communication in the native language.

To make understand the operation and structure of a Technical Office. To provide students with the necessary knowledge for the design and management of projects, their legalization and start-up. To acquire sufficient practice for professional exercise in the Technical Office. To acquire knowledge about the various technical regulations and the standardization of equipment and installations.

syllabus_topics: Topic 01 Technical Office and Engineering 1.1. Types of Technical Offices
Topic 02 The Project and Project Management 2.1. Typology and project life cycle in engineering
Topic 03 Legislation and Regulation 3.1. Normative documents in Industrial Engineering
Topic 04 Processing and Legalization 4.1. Administrative procedures for the start-up of industrial activities
Topic 05 Reports, valuations and appraisals 5.1. Technical documents in Industrial Engineering
Topic 06 Standardization and Certification 6.1. Standards and certification processes in Engineering
Topic 07 Process Diagrams and Plant Layout 7.1. Application of documents, standards and certifications in the field of Plant Engineering
Topic 08. Management of technical documentation in the Project Technical Office 8.1. Organization and management of documents within the Technical Office
teaching_methods: Autonomous student work. Study of theoretical topics and preparation of a monograph related to the subject's syllabus.

assessment_methods.method: Class attendance and/or participation. Attitude towards learning the subject. Motivation for continuous improvement based on acquired knowledge.
